name: Demand & replenishment
prompt: Demand and replenishment: weekly demand trend by category, total units demanded by warehouse, and products below their reorder point.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(date_trunc('week', dh.week) AS DATE) AS week,
  p.category AS category,
  SUM(dh.units) AS demand_units
FROM demand_history AS dh
JOIN products AS p
  ON dh.product_id = p.id
WHERE dh.week >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND dh.week <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY week, category

copy.title: Weekly demand by category
copy.caption: Packaging dominates weekly demand, running well ahead of Bearings and Fasteners.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  w.code AS warehouse,
  SUM(dh.units) AS total_units
FROM demand_history AS dh
JOIN warehouses AS w
  ON dh.warehouse_id = w.id
WHERE dh.week >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND dh.week <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY w.code
ORDER BY total_units DESC, warehouse
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Demand by warehouse
copy.caption: Demand is spread almost evenly across the five warehouses — each handles about 34,000 units.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  SUM(dh.units) AS demand_units
FROM demand_history AS dh
JOIN products AS p
  ON p.id = dh.product_id
WHERE dh.week >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND dh.week <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY demand_units DESC, category
LIMIT 8

copy.title: Demand by category
copy.caption: Packaging and Bearings together make up over half of all unit demand.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  sku,
  product,
  category,
  warehouse,
  region,
  on_hand,
  reorder_point,
  reorder_point - on_hand AS stock_shortfall,
  below_reorder
FROM stock_risk
WHERE below_reorder = TRUE
ORDER BY stock_shortfall DESC, on_hand ASC, sku
LIMIT 50

copy.title: Biggest stock gaps
copy.caption: Corrugated Box L is 752 units below reorder point, the largest shortfall in the list.
